statement.text: Find exotic 3-balls in $S^{4}$, considered up to isotopy rel. boundary. That is, find a pair of 3-balls $B_{1}, B_{2}$ smoothly embedded in $S^{4}$ with the same boundary such that $B_{1}, B_{2}$ are topologically but not smoothly isotopic rel. boundary.

title: Kirby Problem 4.27
